en.summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is the eighteenth mainline entry in Nintendo's tactical RPG series, developed by Intelligent Systems and releasing September 17, 2026 exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 — with no original Switch version planned. Set on the continent of Dagda in the Dagdan Empire, a land ruled by gods for 1,500 years, it centres on the Heroic Games: a gladiatorial tournament held in the capital Dagsion whose winner is granted a single wish.

guideSections.title: Four Protagonists, Four Routes
guideSections.description: Like Three Houses, Fortune's Weave uses a multi-route structure where you pick one of four leads and follow their version of events: Cai, a boy fighting to free his imprisoned father; Dietrich, a swordsman chasing stronger opponents; Theodora, a queen pursuing her homeland's long-held dream; and Leda, a musician seeking revenge.

guideSections.title: Between Matches & the Three Houses Connection
guideSections.description: Between tournament matches you can train at the training grounds, strengthen bonds to recruit allies, and travel beyond Dagsion's walls for extra battles and dungeons. The game shares a world with the Fódlan setting of Three Houses in a different era — an aged Sothis appears in trailers, and Three Houses character designer Chinatsu Kurahana returns, though Koei Tecmo was not involved this time.
